result.description: R2 Sheetmetal & Fabrication Pty Ltd   Construction Estimator     R2 Sheet Metal & Fabrication Pty Ltd  Construction Estimator at Sheet Metal & Fabrication Pty Ltd is responsible for preparing accurate and competitive cost estimates for mechanical ductwork projects. The role involves reviewing engineering plans, specifications, and tender documents to determine project scope, performing detailed quantity take-offs and costings using Autodesk Est MEP, and sourcing and evaluating supplier and subcontractor quotations to ensure cost efficiency.  The position also includes preparing and submitting tender proposals within strict deadlines, identifying cost-saving opportunities, and assessing financial risks associated with bids. The Estimator works closely with the Managing Director, Operations Manager, and clients to ensure estimates accurately reflect project requirements and commercial expectations.  In addition, the role supports the updating and sourcing of cost databases, managing tender documentations and correspondences, and follows up on submitted bids to improve project award success rates. It also assists the operations team with ductwork fabrication data preparation using Autodesk CAMDuct, contributing to smooth project delivery from estimation through production planning.   Work Schedule    Full-time    Salary    $76,000 – 86,000 per year plus superannuation   Paid Sick Leave and other benefits under the ENS       To apply, please submit your resume.    Benefits   Salary    $76,000 – 86,000 per year plus superannuation   Paid Sick Leave and other benefits under the ENS        Task & responsibilities   Tasks and Responsibilities     Analysing mechanical ductwork system plans, specifications and tender documents to determine project scope and requirements;  Preparing detailed cost estimates and quantity take-offs for materials and labour using Autodesk Est MEP;  Sourcing and evaluating subcontractor and supplier quotations to ensure competitive pricing;  Compiling and submitting tender documents and cost proposals in accordance with project deadlines;  Identifying cost-saving opportunities and assessing financial risks associated with project bids;  Liaising with the managing director, operations manager and clients to ensure project scope and pricing are accurately reflected in estimates;  Maintaining and updating the company cost database to reflect current material and labour pricing:  Recording and managing tender documentation and correspondence in shared filing systems and databases;  Monitoring and following up outstanding tenders and quotations to maximise project award opportunities; and  Supporting the operations team in the preparation and input of ductwork fabrication data using Autodesk CAMDuct.       Qualification & experience   Requirements     Holds relevant qualifications in engineering, construction management, mechanical services, or a related technical discipline, with trade experience in sheet metal fabrication or HVAC is considered as an advantage.  Proven experience in estimating, cost planning, or tender preparation within HVAC, ductwork or sheet metal manufacturing.  Strong ability to read and interpret mechanical drawings, technical specifications, and tender documents to prepare accurate quantity take-offs and cost estimates.  Proficiency in estimating and design software such as Autodesk Est MEP, with familiarity in Autodesk CAMDuct or similar fabrication/estimating tools.  Strong analytical and numerical skills with the ability to assess material, labour, and subcontractor costs, while identifying cost-saving and value engineering opportunities.  Excellent communication and coordination skills, with the ability to liaise effectively with management, clients, suppliers, and internal teams to ensure accurate and competitive tender submissions.      About Company    R2 Sheet Metal and Fabrication is a business located at Ottoway South Australia.       Work Type:  Full time   Salary:  $76000-86000   Job Publish:  29-06-2026   Job Expire:  29-07-2026   Apply Link:  https://workinitiatives.com.au/job/details?id=5933921   This job is brought to you by workinitiatives.com.au.

Since 1995, VULCAN has been driven by a singular vision: to be Australasia’s most customer-focused and efficient metals distributor. By delivering superior service, we’ve grown from a carbon steel specialist into an industrial leader.

Today, we provide precision solutions across plate and coil processing, stainless, and engineering steels. With 69 world-class facilities and a team of 1,300+, our strategic expansion ensures we have the scale and expertise to keep the Australasian economy moving.

We are seeking experienced and qualified CNC PROGRAMMER to join our team of hardworking professionals. In this role, you will be responsible for preparing, developing, and optimising programs for Daito CNC Beam Lines and CNC Bandsaws to support accurate, efficient, and safe processing of steel sections.

Your key responsibilities include but will not be limited to:

CNC Programming
Generate CNC programs for Daito Beam Lines and CNC Bandsaws.
Import and prepare DSTV/NC1 files.
Validate machining features including drilling, marking, slotting, and cut lengths.
Apply correct tools, offsets, speeds, and feeds.
Optimise cutting and nesting sequences.
Conduct simulation checks.

Production Integration
Coordinate with schedulers and operators.
Prepare setup sheets and job packets.
Ensure part numbering and traceability as per customer specifications

Quality & Compliance
Verify programs match drawings and specifications.
Support first-off inspections.
Maintain version control.

Equipment & Process Support
Troubleshoot programming issues.

Continuous Improvement
Identify optimisation opportunities.
Maintain programming templates and macros.

Skills & Competencies

Technical Skills
Experience with Daito Beam Line programming and CNC Bandsaws.
Proficient with DSTV/NC1 and CAD/CAM workflows.
Ability to read engineering drawings.
Knowledge of steel profiles.

Professional Competencies:
High attention to detail
Strong problem-solving
Effective communication
Organised and reliable
Safety-focused

If you meet the above criteria and would like to be considered for this position, please apply now!

About the position

•	Handle all building estimating tasks
•	Prepare quantity take-offs, BOQs, cost estimates, and tender submissions for residential and commercial projects.
•	 Review drawings, specifications, and project documentation to develop accurate pricing and budgets. 
•	Assess supplier and subcontractor quotations and prepare cost comparisons. 
•	Monitor project budgets, variations, and cost forecasts throughout project delivery. 
•	Identify cost risks, value engineering opportunities, and cost-saving initiatives. 
•	Assist in pricing HomeKit installation, smart home automation, drainage, renovation, and other building projects.
About you
•	At least two years of experience in residential estimating.

•	Strong analytical skills with the ability to manage multiple estimating tasks and deadlines.
•	Experience in residential and infrastructure projects will be highly regarded.
•	Previous site supervision or construction delivery experience will be highly regarded.

We have Metal Fabricator/Welder positions available across our various locations.  Main duties involve fabricating, welding and conducting repairs on a variety of road transport vehicles and equipment at our local workshops.

Salaries are dependent on skills & experience -
•	Bruce Rock, WA, 6418 - From $85,000 
•	Forrestfield, WA, 6058 - From $79,500 
•	Geraldton, WA, 6530 - From $85,000 
•	Port Hedland, WA, 6721 - From $105,000

These positions are -
•	Full Time Permanent
•	Various rosters available
•	Tool Allowance $35.00 paid fortnightly
•	ASAP Start !

The key responsibilities for these roles include: 
•	Build, develop and produce BRE and other products as required to meet client requirements.
•	Read technical drawings.
•	Select, clean & prepare metal stock.
•	Mark & cut out sections & shapes using hand tools & other workshop equipment.
•	Fit up and fabricate components, in jigs and to drawings.
•	Join metal sections using various welding techniques including MIG and FCAW
•	Examine welds for size, penetration and defects.
•	Diagnose & repair damage as part of the maintenance & service of heavy vehicles.
•	Identify & resolve fabrication difficulties.
•	Meet deadlines & quality requirements to satisfy customer demand.
•	Perform all duties whilst adhering to WHS requirements, & always with the correct use of PPE.
•	Follow systems & procedures & complete paperwork.

Required skills and experience: 
•	Certificate III in Fabrication ideal, but not essential
•	2-3 years of relevant work experience
•	Forklift ticket (high risk licence)
•	Driving licence
•	Have Australian working rights

About the Company:
Bruce Rock Engineering is a leading quality designer, builder and service provider of road transport equipment in Australia. We offer a complete range of trailer solutions to the agricultural, mining, construction and general freight industries nationwide. With the lightest tare weights in Australia, our innovative, high quality trailers are engineered for reliability, durability and performance.

Why work for Bruce Rock Engineering?
•	Great family-based values driven culture.
•	Join a growing, exciting, and professional business with opportunity for growth & career development.
•	Internal movement and progression across 4 sites around WA (Forrestfield, Bruce Rock, Port Hedland, and Geraldton).
•	Regular team BBQ's and active social club.
•	Gain industry-based training and experience, including Apprenticeship programs.
•	Financial support provided for external training.

About the business and the role  

You will be working for a national safety wholesaler with a Perth Head Office. You will be working from your own home office.
Ideally, you are located in Brisbane metro area.

Your role will be to 
1. Manage an existing wholesale client list;
2. Grow the client base with new clients; and
3. Cross selling products to the existing customers. 

The role is an autonomous role, reporting directly to the directors of the company based Perth. 

The business is a family owned company and has been in operation since 1980. The company imports and wholesales consumable safety products including hard hats, gloves, glasses, respirators, and much more. 

The fast changing pace of the industry ensures you are always challenged with different ideas and helping clients solve problems. 

The industry has many standards and we can help you improve your technical knowledge with our in-house training program. 

Job tasks and responsibilities  
The QLD/TAS Account Manager is responsible for servicing key regions including all of Queensland, NSW Northern Rivers. The area also includes all of Tasmania. Due to current structure, the role includes servicing a segment of Victoria.

The role provides great opportunity for travel throughout the key regions. 

You are responsible for planning your call cycles and regional travels to ensure clients are kept up to date with the latest developments. You will work closely with your interstate counterparts in NSW and WA.

In working with the customers, you may be required to undertake joint calls with your customer to visit the end users. 

You are required to report on sales actuals compared to budget on a monthly basis as well as prepare weekly call reports, and update Master Run Sheets.

The role requires you to participate in trade shows/events. 

Skills and experience  
An industrial and safety background is ideal but not mandatory. 

You must have a car to perform this role. 

Competent computer skills are important including being proficient at using Word, Excel, Outlook and Internet. 

A business to business sales call background is ideal. 

This role is open only to Australian Residents/Citizens. 

Successful candidates will be contacted for a phone interview and thereafter a video call and or a face to face interview.

Job benefits and perks  
A salary and motor vehicle allowance is provided. 
Mobile phone with calls and data is covered.

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Cyber Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) Specialist to lead the implementation and continuous improvement of our organisation’s cybersecurity governance framework. This position is pivotal in ensuring that our systems, data, and infrastructure adhere to internal policies and external regulatory obligations, while proactively managing cyber risk and compliance across the enterprise.
You will work closely with executive leadership, IT teams, and external stakeholders to develop strategies, monitor controls, and report on risk posture, audit outcomes, and compliance metrics.
Key Responsibilities
Lead the design, implementation, and management of cybersecurity governance frameworks, including policies, standards, and procedures aligned to ISO 27001, NIST, Essential Eight, and other relevant standards.
Perform risk assessments and control evaluations to identify cybersecurity risks across infrastructure, applications, and third-party vendors.
Develop and maintain the organisation’s information security risk register and assist in the treatment planning and mitigation strategies.
Coordinate internal and external audits related to cybersecurity and manage compliance reporting (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, CPS 234, GDPR).
Provide expert advice to business and IT leaders regarding security requirements, regulatory changes, and risk implications of new projects or technologies.
Monitor compliance with security policies, identify gaps, and drive remediation in collaboration with system and security teams.
Develop metrics and reporting dashboards for executive oversight of cyber risk, control effectiveness, and incident trends.
Lead training and awareness initiatives to embed a culture of security and compliance across all departments.
Liaise with external auditors, regulators, and compliance authorities where required.
Required Skills & Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Risk Management, or related field.
Minimum 5 years of experience in a cybersecurity GRC or Information Security Compliance role.
Strong understanding of risk management frameworks (e.g., ISO 27005, NIST RMF, FAIR), and regulatory standards (e.g., CPS 234, GDPR, PCI-DSS, SOX).
Demonstrated experience leading internal/external security audits and vendor risk assessments.
Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including report writing and executive briefings.
Familiarity with GRC platforms and SIEM tools (e.g., Archer, ServiceNow GRC, Splunk, Microsoft Defender).
Relevant certifications preferred: CISM, CISSP, CRISC, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or equivalent.
Why Join Us?
Work with a dedicated team driving cyber resilience across the organisation.
High-visibility role influencing security posture and risk culture at the executive level.
Career development and upskilling opportunities in a supportive environment.
Flexible working arrangements with a hybrid or remote-friendly structure.

HRS Trailers is a well-established Australian trailer and truck body manufacturer based in Penrith, NSW. We design and manufacture high-quality transport solutions for a wide range of industries, with a strong reputation for reliability, workmanship, and innovation.

Cannon Trailers, Manufacturers of custom-made livestock truck trailers are currently recruiting for multiple Welders and Metal Fabricators to join their manufacturing department in Crows Nest QLD.

-  Evaluate all engineering drawings and ensure implementation according to welding specifications.
-  Perform all welding position work with help of forming and cutting equipment.

-  Perform repair to damaged alloy articles and prepare new articles with help of welding machines.
-  Perform work with help of various hand and power tools.
-  Analyze diagrams and specifications and cut all metal accordingly with help of welding torch.
-  Assist to remove all soft metal for welding.
-  Evaluate finished products and perform quality checks on products.
-  Assemble old units and perform modification and repair work if required.
-  Collaborate work with metal sheets and apply various insulation materials. -Studying blueprints, drawings and specifications to determine job requirements.
-  Cutting marked-out metal sections and shapes using hand tools, flame cutting torches and metal cutting machine.
-  Cleaning and smoothing welds by filing, chiseling and grinding.

-  Ideally have a Certificate III in Engineering Fabrication and or
-  A Minimum of 3 years’ experience in relevant field

Salary range is $70,000 - $85,000pa commensurate with experience.
